# Quilliam AI
> Practical AI consulting, workflow builds, and team training for UK businesses

> Full version: https://quilliam.ai/llms-full.txt
> Last updated: 2026-05-26

## About
Quilliam AI is the trading name of Quilliam AI Ltd (UK Companies House number 17151006, incorporated 2026-04-11, registered office in Cornwall, England). Founded by Levi Quilliam, it helps UK businesses make sense of AI, build useful AI workflows, and train their teams to use them properly.

## Positioning
Most businesses do not need more AI noise. They need one real workflow improved: lead follow-up, admin, support triage, reporting, document handling, or internal knowledge. Quilliam AI starts with the work, decides where AI is useful, adds human controls where needed, and hands the system to the team.

## Services
- AI Opportunity Analysis: plain-English advice on where AI can help, what to do first, and what to ignore.
- Team Training: practical staff training, playbooks, and clear rules for using AI at work.
- AI Implementation: practical AI workflows for repeated admin, follow-up, support, research, reporting, and handoffs.

## Case Study
VetVision AI is a University of Nottingham spin-out using camera systems to monitor animal welfare across equine and dairy environments. Quilliam AI helped make the AI product easier to sell, onboard, operate, and improve through clearer positioning, website redesign, branded onboarding portals, farm and camera operations workflows, and internal AI implementation support. The reported SEO score moved from roughly 40 to 95, with increased visibility, visitors, and leads.

## How It Works
1. Find the work worth fixing: repeated admin, follow-up, triage, reporting, and knowledge-work bottlenecks.
2. Choose the first useful build: define the workflow, controls, owner, and success measure.
3. Build it around existing tools: connect AI to the places the team already works.
4. Hand it to the team: train users, document the system, and tune against real examples.

## Budget Guidance
Quilliam AI quotes by scope because useful AI work depends on the workflow, data, systems, risk, and handoff needs. Training usually starts from £500. Small implementation projects can sit around £2,000-£3,000, medium projects can range from £5,000-£50,000, and larger programmes are usually £50,000+. Every paid engagement is scoped clearly before work starts.
